title: Finite AM-to-line-view coordination boundary
question: After complete exact-head integration succeeds, can one accepted AM syntax projection and the built-in closed LineView be paired through the same independently supplied WholeCut6 while preserving exact shared occurrence order, complete line-channel order and the source residual ledger?
objects: one independently supplied valid closed WholeCut6
one AMTerm accepted against that WholeCut6
one exact LineView derived from the same WholeCut6
one paired coordination witness retaining shared and view-specific ledgers
types: Exact project-original frozen Python dataclass constructors from the Research 0102/0267 test-local model
quantifiers: All 13 explicit Bootstrap Zero test modules for integration; then the canonical closed fixture, one fresh independently named closed fixture, and six fixed refusal controls
arithmetic_domain: none; occurrence multiplicities are retained finite natural labels, not additive-zero, multiplicative-unit or probability semantics
candidate_grammar: PairedLineCoordination(AMTerm, WholeCut6, LineView, ordered occurrence ledger, ordered channel ledger, ordered residual ledger)
evaluation: the explicit 13-module Bootstrap Zero suite passes without shell wildcard expansion
the paired witness is derived only after independent WholeCut6 and AM formation checks
AM and LineView retain one identical ordered whole/source/occurrence/type/multiplicity ledger
LineView retains the exact ordered channel names, endpoints, motion and thread steps
the paired witness retains the exact ordered source residual ledger even though LineView alone does not expose it
a fresh source reuses the relation without reusing whole, occurrence or channel identities; both closed sources retain their exact necessarily empty residual ledger
substituted source/view, reordered ports, omitted channel, altered residual and open-source controls are refused
forbidden_conflations: paired syntax coordinates with semantic interpretation agreement
LineView projection with reconstructing every WholeCut6 field from LineView alone
retained residuals in the pairing witness with residual preservation by bare LineView
shared occurrence coordinates with object identity or a native source admission
closed line view with CircleView, relation filler or M6 filler
finite pairing with Research 0090 coverage, Research 0092 promotion or universal grammar
stop: If explicit integration fails, retain the failure and do not add the LineView relation. Otherwise execute the fixed positive, fresh reuse and refusal family once, with at most one implementation correction replay.
residual: Circle/thread/logic views, routing, collision, fibres, split, traversal, every declared exception, Rust correspondence, observer invariance, 0090 coverage, 0092 generation/promotion/reuse, semantic agreement and practical task value remain open.
